channel.title: Zambia - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Zambia, every source cited.

item.title: Moody's upgrades Zambia's credit rating to Caa1
item.description: The rating agency cited progress in debt restructuring and fiscal consolidation following the country's 2020 default.

item.title: Heavy rains blow roof off zambian teacher's house
item.description: Buyaka Primary School in Kawambwa District faces infrastructure concerns ahead of El Nino.

item.title: Zambia wins global green leadership roles
item.description: The nation secured vice-president roles for the Global Green Growth Institute's assembly and council for 2027-2028.

item.title: Chief urges embrace of Grow Zambia Agenda
item.description: Traditional leader Chief Chisunka says the initiative aims to improve livelihoods and create economic opportunities, not seize land.

item.title: Konkola Copper Mines employs 14,500 in Zambia
item.description: The mining giant's workforce has grown by 30 percent since Vedanta's reinstatement, with salaries also increasing.
